milestones.text: spent their first real session on {hobby} and came away wanting more
milestones.post: First proper go. I'm hooked, I think.

milestones.text: read everything they could find about {hobby} in a single evening
milestones.post: Read about it all evening. Brain full.

milestones.text: bought their first proper supplies for {hobby}
milestones.post: Got the basics. Now I have no excuses.

milestones.text: made a complete mess of their first attempt and laughed about it
milestones.post: Gloriously bad first attempt. Laughed the whole way through.

milestones.text: asked an old hand one question about {hobby} and got an hour of answers
milestones.post: Asked one question. Got an hour of wisdom.

milestones.text: set aside a regular time each week for {hobby}
milestones.post: It's in the week now. Protected time.

milestones.text: cleared a corner at home just for {hobby}
milestones.post: A whole corner, just for this. Feels real now.

milestones.text: learned the proper names for the things they had been calling 'the thingy'
milestones.post: Turns out the thingy has a name. Several names.

milestones.text: made it through a whole session without needing to start over
milestones.post: No restarts today. Tiny victory.

milestones.text: told a friend about {hobby} and talked for far longer than planned
milestones.post: Talked a friend's ear off. Sorry, friend.

milestones.text: found out how much there is still to learn about {hobby}, and was delighted
milestones.post: So much to learn. Brilliant.

milestones.text: started a little notebook to track their progress at {hobby}
milestones.post: Notebook started. Page one: hope.

milestones.text: got up early to fit in some {hobby} before the day began
milestones.post: Early start, quiet house, good session.

milestones.text: tried {hobby} in front of someone else for the first time
milestones.post: Did it in front of an audience of one. Survived.

milestones.text: looked up from {hobby} to find three whole hours had gone by
milestones.post: Three hours vanished. Didn't notice once.

milestones.text: had their first attempt they were not embarrassed by
milestones.post: First attempt I'm not hiding. Progress.

milestones.text: watched a seasoned expert at work and took careful mental notes
milestones.post: Watched an expert. Took mental notes. Many of them.

milestones.text: found a secondhand bargain that made {hobby} much easier
milestones.post: Secondhand find, life improved.

milestones.text: stuck with {hobby} through a frustrating week instead of giving up
milestones.post: Frustrating week. Didn't quit. That's the win.

milestones.text: picked up a bit of the jargon and used a word of it correctly
milestones.post: Used the jargon correctly. Nobody laughed.

milestones.text: chose {hobby} over a lie-in on a rainy morning
milestones.post: Rainy morning, chose this over bed. Commitment.

milestones.text: booked a first lesson with a patient teacher
milestones.post: First lesson booked. Teacher seems patient. Good.

milestones.text: kept up {hobby} every week for three months straight
milestones.post: Three months, every week. A real habit.

milestones.text: did something without thinking that used to take real effort
milestones.post: Did it without thinking. Used to be so hard.

milestones.text: spotted their own mistake before anyone pointed it out
milestones.post: Caught my own mistake. Growing up.

milestones.text: found a group of fellow enthusiasts and went along for the first time
milestones.post: Met my people today. Very nice people.

milestones.text: explained the basics of {hobby} to a curious friend
milestones.post: Explained it to a friend. Sounded like I knew things.

milestones.text: had a session where everything just clicked
milestones.post: Today it clicked. Hoping it stays clicked.

milestones.text: replaced their beginner gear with something better
milestones.post: Upgraded. Felt like I'd earned it.

milestones.text: filled their first {hobby} notebook and started another
milestones.post: Notebook two. The saga continues.

milestones.text: managed a technique that looked impossible a month ago
milestones.post: Last month: impossible. Today: done.

milestones.text: looked back at their very first attempts and laughed fondly
milestones.post: Looked at my early efforts. Oh dear. Oh, bless.

milestones.text: made it through a tricky part they had been dreading
milestones.post: Got past the tricky bit. Celebrating with tea.

milestones.text: set themselves a small goal and met it a week early
milestones.post: Goal met early. Setting a bigger one.

milestones.text: got a genuine compliment from someone who knows {hobby} well
milestones.post: A real compliment from someone who knows. Glowing.

milestones.text: worked out a routine for {hobby} that actually fits their week
milestones.post: Routine sorted. It fits.

milestones.text: kept going through a long plateau and came out the other side
milestones.post: Plateau over. Moving again.

milestones.text: taught themselves a new trick from an old book
milestones.post: Old book, new trick.

milestones.text: started to have strong opinions about the right way to do {hobby}
milestones.post: I have opinions now. Strong ones. Brace yourselves.

milestones.text: brought a friend along to try {hobby}, and the friend enjoyed it
milestones.post: Friend tried it. Friend liked it. Mission accomplished.

milestones.text: spent a whole free day on {hobby} without getting bored once
milestones.post: Whole day. Not bored once.

milestones.text: kept their workspace tidy for an entire month
milestones.post: Workspace still tidy after a month. Shocking.

milestones.text: sorted out a common problem on their own without asking anyone
milestones.post: Fixed it myself. No help needed.

milestones.text: got through a whole session without checking the instructions once
milestones.post: No instructions needed today.

milestones.text: had a session so good it made them grin all evening
milestones.post: Grinning all evening. Great session.

milestones.text: was asked for advice by someone newer to {hobby}
milestones.post: Someone asked my advice. Tried to look wise.

milestones.text: tried something ambitious and pulled it off
milestones.post: Aimed high. Got there.

milestones.text: came up with a small trick of their own that the old hands liked
milestones.post: My own little trick. The old hands approve.

milestones.text: spent a weekend away given over entirely to {hobby}
milestones.post: A whole weekend of it. Bliss.

milestones.text: kept careful records for six months and saw real progress on paper
milestones.post: Six months of notes. Look how far I've come.

milestones.text: had a stranger stop and watch a whole {hobby} session
milestones.post: A stranger stopped to watch. Tried not to show off. Failed.

milestones.text: talked {hobby} for an hour with someone long admired
milestones.post: Met someone I really admire. Talked for an hour.

milestones.text: noticed details they would not even have seen a year ago
milestones.post: Seeing things I'd never have noticed before.

milestones.text: saved up for a really good piece of kit and finally bought it
milestones.post: Saved up. Bought it. Worth it.

milestones.text: turned a spectacular failure into the best lesson yet
milestones.post: Failed spectacularly. Learned enormously.

milestones.text: set a personal best and wrote the date down
milestones.post: Personal best. Date noted.

milestones.text: worked through an advanced book on {hobby} cover to cover
milestones.post: Finished the advanced book. Head spinning, in a good way.

milestones.text: started helping out at the local group's meetings
milestones.post: Helping run the meetings now. Tea duty and wisdom duty.

milestones.text: passed their old beginner gear on to someone just starting out
milestones.post: Passed on my old gear. Hope it treats them well.

milestones.text: found a style of their own within {hobby}
milestones.post: Starting to have my own style. Exciting.

milestones.text: kept practising through a busy month without missing a week
milestones.post: Busy month. Didn't miss a week.

milestones.text: entered their first small contest and finished comfortably in the middle
milestones.post: Mid-table in my first contest. Not last! Celebrating.

milestones.text: travelled to the next town for a gathering of {hobby} enthusiasts
milestones.post: Travelled for a gathering. So many people like me.

milestones.text: worked out for themselves something the books skipped over
milestones.post: Worked it out myself. The books skipped it.

milestones.text: practised a hard part fifty times until it finally came out right
milestones.post: Fifty tries. The fifty-first was perfect.

milestones.text: spent their birthday money on {hobby} without a second thought
milestones.post: Birthday money, well spent.

milestones.text: took {hobby} along on a trip and found new inspiration away from home
milestones.post: Brought it on holiday. New place, new ideas.

milestones.text: taught a complete beginner the basics of {hobby}
milestones.post: Taught my first beginner. They were brilliant.

milestones.text: entered their first proper competition and placed respectably
milestones.post: Respectable finish. Very respectable. Thrilled.

milestones.text: was asked to show what they can do at a local gathering
milestones.post: Showing my stuff at the gathering. Nervous and proud.

milestones.text: gave a short talk about {hobby} to an interested crowd
milestones.post: Gave a talk. People asked questions. Good questions!

milestones.text: marked a full year of keeping up {hobby}
milestones.post: One year in. Still in love with it.

milestones.text: was trusted with a task the old hands usually keep for themselves
milestones.post: They let me do the important bit today.

milestones.text: won a small prize at a local contest
milestones.post: Won a little prize. Pinned it up.

milestones.text: helped organise a gathering for fellow enthusiasts
milestones.post: Helped run the gathering. Everyone had a lovely time.

milestones.text: turned their keenest rival from the next town over into a friend
milestones.post: My rival is my friend now. Friendly competition.

milestones.text: found themselves explaining the finer points to people with more years in
milestones.post: Explaining the finer points to veterans. How did this happen.

milestones.text: achieved the goal they wrote down on day one
milestones.post: Day one goal: done. Look at that.

milestones.text: was named by a newcomer as the reason for taking up {hobby}
milestones.post: Someone started because of me. Best feeling.

milestones.text: spent a full week on a big project and finished it properly
milestones.post: Big project, finished properly. Very satisfying.

milestones.text: became the person the group asks when something goes wrong
milestones.post: I'm the troubleshooter now. Bring me your problems.

milestones.text: was invited to join a more experienced group
milestones.post: Invited to the experienced group. Trying to act casual.

milestones.text: kept a promise to themselves to do {hobby} every day for a month
milestones.post: Every day for a month. Promise kept.

milestones.text: worked out a clever method that others in the group started copying
milestones.post: They're copying my method. Flattered.

milestones.text: was named at a gathering as one to watch
milestones.post: Someone called me 'one to watch'. Gulp.

milestones.text: realised they no longer felt like a beginner at all
milestones.post: Not a beginner anymore. When did that happen?

milestones.text: travelled further than ever before to take part in an event
milestones.post: Longest trip yet, for the best event yet.

milestones.text: ran a little taster session for friends who wanted to try {hobby}
milestones.post: Ran a taster for friends. Recruits secured.

milestones.text: was trusted to look after the group's shared supplies
milestones.post: Keeper of the group's supplies. A great honour.

milestones.text: took first place at a regional competition
milestones.post: First place. I keep looking at the ribbon.

milestones.text: was asked to lead a workshop for newcomers
milestones.post: Leading the workshop now. Full circle.

milestones.text: completed the big challenge they had been working toward for years
milestones.post: Years of work. Done. Can't stop smiling.

milestones.text: was invited to judge at a local contest
milestones.post: Judging instead of competing. Strange and lovely.

milestones.text: was sought out by someone who travelled a long way just to learn
milestones.post: Someone travelled for days to learn from me. Humbling.

milestones.text: mentored a newcomer all the way to a first prize
milestones.post: My student won! Prouder than if I had.

milestones.text: was made an honorary member of the local society
milestones.post: Honorary member. There was a speech. I blushed.

milestones.text: did something at a gathering that people still talk about
milestones.post: Apparently they're still talking about it. Blushing.

milestones.text: set a personal record that may stand for a long time
milestones.post: New record. Good luck beating it, future me.

milestones.text: was asked to write a guide to {hobby} for beginners
milestones.post: Writing the beginners' guide. Remembering how lost I was.

milestones.text: had their best work put on show for the public
milestones.post: On public display. Strangers looked. Strangers liked.

milestones.text: won the top prize in a contest with entrants from far away
milestones.post: Beat entrants from all over. Still stunned.

milestones.text: could now do in minutes what once took a whole afternoon
milestones.post: What used to take hours takes minutes now.

milestones.text: became known around town as the one to ask about {hobby}
milestones.post: Known as the expert around town now. Gulp.

milestones.text: taught a class of eager beginners every week for a season
milestones.post: A whole season of teaching. They all got better.

milestones.text: hosted a gathering at home for enthusiasts from all around
milestones.post: House full of enthusiasts. Best evening in ages.

milestones.text: heard an old master of {hobby} call their work outstanding
milestones.post: An old master said 'outstanding'. Dining out on that for years.

milestones.text: looked back over years of {hobby} and felt quietly proud
milestones.post: Years of it. Quietly proud.

milestones.text: was asked to represent the local group at a big event
milestones.post: Representing the group. Practising my wave.

milestones.text: achieved something nobody in their circle had managed before
milestones.post: First in our circle to do it. Wow.

milestones.text: gave a demonstration at a big public fair and drew a crowd
milestones.post: Demonstrated at the fair. A crowd gathered. I didn't wobble.

milestones.text: watched beginner videos about {hobby} late into the night
milestones.post: One more beginner video. Then bed. Then one more.

milestones.text: joined an online group for {hobby} beginners and lurked happily
milestones.post: Lurking in the beginners' group. Learning a lot.

milestones.text: posted their progress in an online group and got encouraging replies
milestones.post: Posted my progress. Strangers were kind. Faith restored.

milestones.text: had a post about their {hobby} shared widely online
milestones.post: My post got shared around. Strange and lovely.

milestones.text: started a small online page about their {hobby} and gained a few followers
milestones.post: Started a page. Twelve followers. Hello, twelve.

milestones.text: made a tutorial video about {hobby} that thousands of people watched
milestones.post: Thousands watched my tutorial video. Teaching the world, one view at a time.

milestones.text: had a piece about their {hobby} printed in the local paper
milestones.post: In the paper! The neighbours keep mentioning it.

sessions.text: Lost track of time, in the good way.
Kept at one tricky bit until it behaved.
Made a few notes for next time.
Found it a welcome break from the week.
Tried one new thing and stuck with the old favourites for the rest.
Had a slow start and a good finish.
Went back over the basics, which helped.
Felt pleasantly tired and quite pleased afterwards.
Did a little less than planned, which was fine.
Spent a while just enjoying it, no goals.
Came away with a small idea to try next time.
Got properly absorbed for an hour or so.
Thought about it for the rest of the evening.
Ran into a snag and worked around it.
Had one of those sessions where everything felt easy.
